scope: ERP backend correctness: auth/session validity, PO/SO/inventory rules, finance/FX, schema/migrations/seed, backend test harness, contracts package.

findings.title: A refresh rotation in flight during a password change or deactivation leaves the rotated session alive (cookie and OAuth)
findings.proposed_fix: Serialise rotation with credential changes on the user row. In rotateRefresh and rotateRefreshToken, lock `users` FOR SHARE (or FOR KEY SHARE) before the token row, matching the code-redemption order. Make every credential change take `SELECT ... FROM users WHERE id = X FOR UPDATE` before its revoke. Better still, stamp the family with the credential_version it was issued under and refuse rotation when it differs, so a missed row cannot outlive the change. That is the 'centralize session and credential validity' carryover.
findings.regression_test: Keep the repro's two A1-01 cases with the assertions flipped: after a password change, the rotated other-family rt and OAuth refresh token must be refused, and /api/me must return 401. Add deactivate -> reactivate -> old rotated rt refused.

findings.title: A refresh rotation racing a manager password reset deadlocks (40P01) and one request answers 500
findings.proposed_fix: Same lock order as A1-01: rotations take the user row first, so the reset and the rotation queue rather than deadlock.
findings.regression_test: Repro 'A1-02' with the assertion flipped: both requests return non-5xx.

findings.title: No retention for session, attempt and OAuth tables; login_attempts takes anonymous writes
findings.proposed_fix: Add a daily sweep, for example in the web-submission purge loop or a sibling: login_attempts older than about 1 day, refresh rows revoked or expired more than N days ago (keep enough for reuse detection), expired codes and pending consent, and public_form_reservations older than 10 minutes.
findings.regression_test: Sweep test: seed expired and old rows plus live rows; only the expired ones go, and reuse detection still works for a family's recently revoked rows.

findings.title: MCP tool failures return raw error messages, including Postgres errors, and unvalidated `limit` args reach SQL
findings.proposed_fix: Validate numeric and UUID args at the tool boundary with clean messages. In the catch, return e.message only for errors the tools throw on purpose (a ToolError class), and a generic 'tool call failed' otherwise.
findings.regression_test: mcp-server.test: list_market_values with limit 'x' and -5, and create_sell_order_draft with inventoryId 'nope', return isError with a clean message containing no 'syntax'/'type' Postgres text.

findings.title: Workspace PATCH stores unvalidated values for keys the public-form budget and MCP read
findings.proposed_fix: Add validators for the budget keys (positive integers) and mcp.sellOrderCustomerId (UUID of an existing customer), or have getWorkspaceSetting fall back when the stored type differs from the fallback's.
findings.regression_test: workspace PATCH with public_form_daily_submissions:'abc' returns 400; the intake form still admits after a bad legacy row is present.

findings.title: Shutdown stops loops without waiting for an in-flight tick; the web-submission purge loop has no stop flag
findings.proposed_fix: Give the purge loop a `stopped` flag checked between batches. Have loops expose the promise of their current tick so onShutdown can await it (bounded by graceMs) before closeDb.
findings.regression_test: shutdown.test: a loop whose tick is pending delays closeDb until it settles or graceMs passes; purge stops between batches after stop().

findings.title: Inventory PATCH can move a line out of Sold or off a pending transfer, bypassing the PO cascade's status rules
findings.proposed_fix: Share cascadeBlockers' rules with the inventory editor: refuse leaving Sold, refuse status changes on lines whose transfer_order_id is a Pending transfer, and when the new status is not sellable also check open draft/packing claims (or require a confirm).
findings.regression_test: Sell a lot out to Done, PATCH /api/inventory/:id {status:'Done'} -> 409; PATCH an In Transit line under a Pending transfer -> 409.

findings.title: Deleting a transfer's source warehouse (no transferTo) makes discard of that transfer fail with an FK 500 forever
findings.proposed_fix: Refuse warehouse delete while Pending transfers have lines whose transferred events name it, or have discard verify the origin exists and fall back to NULL / transferTo; write a warehouse_reassigned inventory_event per moved line.
findings.regression_test: Create pending transfer from WH-A, DELETE /api/warehouses/WH-A, POST discard -> 200 (or 409 on the delete), never 500.

findings.title: Archive's removeFromSellOrders is a bare boolean; the removal set is recomputed after the manager confirms
findings.proposed_fix: Have the client echo the confirmed sol_id set and return a fresh 409 if claimed differs; lock the SOs named by claimed before the line lock (re-read until stable).
findings.regression_test: Archive -> 409 listing SO-1; add line to SO-2 and ship; retry with removeFromSellOrders -> expect 409 listing SO-2, SO-2 unchanged.

findings.title: Transfer receive/reopen/discard lock lines with no ORDER BY
findings.proposed_fix: Add ORDER BY l.id to the locking SELECTs; lock clones and peers together in sorted order.
findings.regression_test: Add receive-vs-advance pair to tests/stock-lock-order.test.ts.

findings.title: Reopen + discard of a transfer can delete a clone lot a Draft sell order names
findings.proposed_fix: Give reopen the proposal/confirmDrafts check transfer create uses; in discard refuse (or skip merge) when an open SO names the clone.
findings.regression_test: The scenario above returns 409 or keeps C referenced.

findings.title: PATCH can blank required names (remaining half of BD-08); supplier PATCH 500s on duplicate match_key and bad nextFollowUpAt/cadenceDays
findings.proposed_fix: Require nonblank trimmed name/label in PATCH validators; map unique violation to 409; validate date and integer cadence.
findings.regression_test: PATCH {name:''} on each -> 400; duplicate rename -> 409.

findings.title: Sell-order unitPrice has no upper bound or scale check: numeric overflow is a 500
findings.proposed_fix: Cap unitPrice (like afterSales MAX_AMOUNT) and reject >2 decimals before conversion.
findings.regression_test: POST unitPrice:1e10 -> 400.

findings.title: After-sales summary silently drops RMB cases when no USD/CNY rate exists, and uses a different rate than accounting
findings.proposed_fix: Return an unconverted count (or fall back to latest rate) and pick one conversion rule for both screens.
findings.regression_test: Summary with an RMB case and empty fx_rates does not report a silent 0.

findings.title: RS-483 did not update docs/DATABASE.md for after_sales_cases.currency_code
findings.proposed_fix: Add currency_code char(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD', CHECK IN ('USD','CNY'), 'amount is in currency_code'.
findings.regression_test: n/a (docs)

findings.title: Duplicate-lot sell-order diff pairs occurrences by position, mislabelling removals as edits (residual of BD-07)
findings.proposed_fix: Cancel identical snapshots first (tupleKey multiset), then pair the remainder by fewest changed fields.
findings.regression_test: diffSellOrderLines([X/2/New,X/3/Used],[X/3/Used]) -> removed=[X/2/New], edited=[]; swapped order -> empty diff.

findings.title: Sub-cent PO values revert a submitted PO to Draft for an edit that never lands
findings.proposed_fix: Round money inputs to 2 dp before comparing; only write reverted when something changed.
findings.regression_test: PATCH Reviewing PO with stored+0.003 -> lifecycle stays reviewing, no reverted event.

findings.title: Draft PO delete reads sell-order claims without locking the lines
findings.proposed_fix: Lock the PO's lines ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE before the claim check.
findings.regression_test: Two-connection interleave -> 409 or clean, never NULL inventory_id.

findings.title: Package subqueries inside locking SELECTs read a pre-wait snapshot
findings.proposed_fix: Read packages in a separate statement after the lock.
findings.regression_test: Barrier test: advance waits on PATCH inserting a package, then succeeds.

findings.title: 'submitted' order event records raw line sum, ignoring a negotiated lot price
findings.proposed_fix: Record COALESCE(o.total_cost, SUM(COALESCE(qty_purchased,qty)*unit_cost)).
findings.regression_test: Submit a pinned-total PO and assert detail.totalCost.

findings.title: GET /api/inventory/:id leaks transfer_order_id to purchasers
findings.proposed_fix: delete r.transfer_order_id in the purchaser branch.
findings.regression_test: Purchaser GET asserts no transfer_order_id.

findings.title: [carryover BD-11] services/orderAdvance.ts and routes/sellOrders.ts import packing persistence from a route module
findings.proposed_fix: Move keyedLines/prunePackRows into services/sellOrderPack.ts; add an import-boundary lint.
findings.regression_test: Existing sell-order-pack / orders-archive tests stay green; boundary check passes.

findings.title: resetDb is not serialised: a reset that outlives its hook timeout races the next test's reset, turning one slow test into a cascade of unrelated failures
findings.proposed_fix: Chain resetDb onto a module-level promise (`let resetting = Promise.resolve(); export function resetDb(){ return resetting = resetting.catch(()=>{}).then(doReset); }`) so a second call waits for the first, and make the CREATE tolerate an existing clone by DROP … WITH (FORCE) immediately before it. Optionally raise hookTimeout or make resetDb time-boxed with AbortSignal so an abandoned reset cannot outlive its test.
findings.regression_test: docs/review-2026-10-31/repro/A2t/reset-cascade.repro.test.ts (run with its vitest.repro.config.ts) must pass after the fix; it fails 3/3 today.

findings.title: wave2b Fix 3b and Fix 3c pass whatever the PO back-advance guard does; the "Done sell order frees the line" branch is untested
findings.proposed_fix: Fix 3b: attach an open sell order to a line before advancing forward. Fix 3c: assert each SO status call is 200, then advance done -> reviewing -> in_transit and expect 200.
findings.regression_test: Mutate the guard to treat Done SOs as open; Fix 3c must fail.

findings.title: Goods-total tests pass vacuously: the 0-to-NULL test starts at NULL and four "leave it alone" tests never check their PATCH succeeded
findings.proposed_fix: Price the line first (as inventory.test.ts:148 does) and assert each PATCH status is 200.
findings.regression_test: Make the PATCH return 400; the four tests must fail.

findings.title: Tests titled with "no writes"/"keeps X"/"unchanged" never check the mutation was attempted or that the named fields stayed
findings.location: apps/backend/tests/orders.test.ts:484-507; orders.test.ts:589-612; inventory.test.ts:390-408; item-types.test.ts:133-143; order-box-checks.test.ts:234-241; transfer-orders.test.ts:408-419,624-636; sellOrder-price-adjust.test.ts:306; wave2b-fixes.test.ts:111-118; suppliers-adopt.test.ts:53-56; orders-on-behalf.test.ts:160-178
findings.proposed_fix: Assert every setup/subject request status; assert every field the title names (commissionRate, totalCost, line warehouse/status); compare event counts with toBe(before) where the title promises none.
findings.regression_test: Inject a write before the 409 return in the PATCH handler; orders.test.ts:484 must fail.

findings.title: Negative-only scoping/filter tests have no positive control, so an endpoint that returns nothing passes
findings.proposed_fix: Add the positive half (manager sees it / unfiltered list contains it / linked before unlink) before each negative assertion.
findings.regression_test: Make the endpoint return [] unconditionally; each test must fail.

findings.title: Lock-wait race tests rely on a fixed 300 ms sleep instead of waiting for the blocked backend
findings.proposed_fix: Replace pause(300) with the waitBlocked() helper (move it to tests/helpers) and assert the request was observed waiting before release().
findings.regression_test: Remove FOR UPDATE in the guarded path; test must fail deterministically, not only on fast machines.

findings.title: Count/metric assertions too weak to catch the regression they name
findings.proposed_fix: Read the count before and assert toBe(before + n).
findings.regression_test: Make appendPriceEvent a no-op; ref-price-events must fail.

findings.title: Vacuous loops and silent early returns over possibly-empty results
findings.proposed_fix: Assert non-empty (toBeGreaterThan(0)) before each loop; replace silent returns with expect(b).toBeDefined().
findings.regression_test: Make page 2 return []; pagination tests must fail.

findings.title: Wall-clock and calendar dependence in assertions
findings.proposed_fix: Use vi.useFakeTimers/vi.setSystemTime for dates; for ReDoS, assert step counts or use a generous budget relative to a baseline measured in the same test.
findings.regression_test: Run with TZ and system time set to 23:59:59.900 UTC; tests must stay green.

findings.title: part-merge test can pass without the migration rewriting any line
findings.proposed_fix: Seed the RAM line with the spelling that must lose (assert winner != original first), then assert it changed.
findings.regression_test: Delete the UPDATE order_lines step from the merge SQL; test must fail.

findings.title: sell-order PO line number assertions compare null to null
findings.proposed_fix: expect(noOf(id)).not.toBeNull() and distinctness before comparing.
findings.regression_test: Drop the BEFORE INSERT trigger in a test DB; test must fail.

findings.title: /api/client-timings has no test
findings.proposed_fix: Add a small test: 401 without cookie, 400 without loadEvent, 204 on valid body, 429 after 20.
findings.regression_test: That test.

findings.title: Manual FX override has no upper bound; a typo becomes the rate every CNY sale and USD book entry uses
findings.proposed_fix: Validate at the boundary with the bound the book already uses: 0 < rate <= 100, or a sanity band around the latest frankfurter rate (for example ±20%) that needs explicit confirmation. Share one constant with accounting's MAX_RATE. Consider a CHECK on fx_rates.rate too.
findings.regression_test: fx-routes.test.ts: POST rate 7100 returns 400 and stores no row; POST 0.000000001 returns 400; a valid override still returns 201 and is used by a USD accounting entry with no fxRate. Repro: docs/review-2026-10-31/repro/A3/a3-repro.test.ts (asserts current defect; passed 2/2).

findings.title: Archived POs still count in the purchaser projection, the leaderboard and the contribution revenue/profit cards, though spend and Home exclude them
findings.proposed_fix: Put `po.archived_at IS NULL` in one shared 'reviewed and live' fragment and use it in projDateWin/projPrevWin, both leaderboard CTEs and contributions' `reviewed`. The manager realized lens joins POs through sale lines and should stay as is: an archive pulls lines off open sell orders, and a Done sale is history.
findings.regression_test: dashboard-projected.test.ts: an archived reviewed PO adds nothing to the purchaser KPIs, the series, contrib revenue/profit/count or the leaderboard, and its unarchive restores it. Repro: docs/review-2026-10-31/repro/A3/a3-repro.test.ts (asserts current defect; passed 2/2).

findings.title: The dashboard fans out about 19 queries at once with Promise.all, against the pool's max of 10 and the backend's 4-at-a-time rule
findings.proposed_fix: Use allLimited for both fan-outs (and for market.ts:76/335 for consistency). Better still, fold the contributions queries into fewer GROUPING SETS statements.
findings.regression_test: None functional. A lint or grep check for Promise.all over sql in routes/services, or a test that spies on pool concurrency.

findings.title: A payment equal to goods plus fees never ranks 'exact', so the true match never gets the one-click Link
findings.proposed_fix: Compute exact against both bases (goods and goods+fees, the one the SQL ranked by) and report amountDiff against the nearer one. Use goods+fees for `covered`.
findings.regression_test: banktx-match.test.ts: the goods+fees case returns reason 'exact', confidence 'high' and amountDiff 0.

findings.title: /unassign and /note write a payment group from an unlocked read, unlike every other verdict
findings.proposed_fix: Wrap both in sql.begin with lockBankGroupTx + groupOf, as /assign does.
findings.regression_test: A barrier test: hold the group lock, start /note, pair the legs, release. Both legs end with the new note.

findings.title: Links judge the target PO/SO's archived or closed state without locking it
findings.proposed_fix: Lock the target row (FOR NO KEY UPDATE) inside the transaction and re-check archived, closed or payment on the locked row. Use one documented order, orders before bank rows, in both /link and linkPaypalTxnToOrder.
findings.regression_test: A barrier race: archive vs /link ends with either a refused link or an unarchived linked PO, never both archived and linked.

findings.title: Market search treats % and _ as wildcards
findings.proposed_fix: Pass escapeLike(search) here as /parts does.
findings.regression_test: market-pagination.test.ts: q='_' returns only labels or PNs that contain an underscore.

findings.title: A manual price of 0 is accepted and zeroes the part's max buy, the case the importer refuses
findings.proposed_fix: Require price > 0 (and the import's ceiling) on manual entry, or give 'not buying' its own explicit state.
findings.regression_test: market-manual-price.test.ts: price 0 returns 400.

findings.title: Market 'Internal sales (30d)' averages archived and Draft PO lines
findings.proposed_fix: Add o.archived_at IS NULL and, if intended, o.lifecycle <> 'draft'.
findings.regression_test: market-internal-sales.test.ts: an archived PO's line does not change avgPrice or samples.

findings.title: [cross-lane] CNY sell lines store a per-unit USD price rounded to cents, so realized revenue drifts with quantity
findings.proposed_fix: Store the USD line total, or keep 4+ decimal places on unit_price for converted lines, and round only the line total.
findings.regression_test: A sell order in CNY with qty 1000 at ¥1.00 has a line total within $0.01 of ¥1000/7.2.

findings.title: The booking rate and the review ledger rate pick 'latest' by different keys
findings.proposed_fix: Pick the latest rate one way for both: by effective_date, then fetched_at.
findings.regression_test: An fx unit test with a manual row for today, then a frankfurter row for yesterday fetched later: both readers return the same rate.

findings.title: POST /internal-transactions/:id/members checks the record outside the transaction
findings.proposed_fix: Read the record FOR KEY SHARE inside the transaction.
findings.regression_test: A barrier test: delete racing add returns 404, not 500.

findings.title: Migration ledger accepts renamed/deleted files silently; dev ledger holds a deleted migration (0216_fleet_cities_drop_pinned.sql) that would hang the keep-fleet restore
findings.proposed_fix: migrate.mjs: log a warning (or fail in CI) for ledger rows whose file is missing. sync.sh/keep-fleet.sql: capture only filenames that exist in the image's migrations directory, or compare against the files list instead of the old ledger. Add a CI check that no migration filename is deleted or renamed relative to origin/main.
findings.regression_test: migration-ledger.test.ts: insert a ledger row for a missing file and assert migrate.mjs warns; CI script diffing `git diff --name-status origin/main -- apps/backend/migrations` for D/R entries.

findings.title: docs/DATABASE.md misses four migrated columns
findings.proposed_fix: Add the four rows to the DATABASE.md tables; correct the amount note for after_sales_cases.
findings.regression_test: A docs check that every information_schema column of a migrated DB appears in its DATABASE.md section (the shell loop used here is ~10 lines).

findings.title: seed.mjs re-run aborts half-way when a bank row is linked to a sell order, leaving a partially wiped dev DB
findings.proposed_fix: Before deleting sell_orders/orders, UPDATE bank_transactions SET order_id=NULL, sell_order_id=NULL, link_kind=NULL, linked_at=NULL (or delete them), and run the whole reset section in one transaction.
findings.regression_test: Integration test: seed, link a bank row to a sell order, run seed.mjs again on the private worker DB, assert exit 0.

findings.title: 0178's NOT VALID check can be validated now
findings.proposed_fix: New migration: ALTER TABLE bank_transactions VALIDATE CONSTRAINT bank_transactions_ignored_unlinked_check (SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE lock only).
findings.regression_test: Assert convalidated = true for every CHECK on bank_transactions in a migrated DB.

findings.title: Coordinator proxy keeps two allowlisted routes no UI calls, one of them a credential write
findings.proposed_fix: Drop both routes and their tests, or wire them to a page. If the credential form is planned, record it in a ticket.
findings.regression_test: The coordinator-routes allowlist test asserts 404 for PUT /api/coordinator/accounts/x and GET /api/coordinator/stats/reviews.

findings.title: Reddit proxy forwards rule create/edit/delete that no UI calls
findings.proposed_fix: Remove the three write routes from tracker.ts (and the root/trackers/reddit AGENTS.md lists), or add the rule editor they were meant for.
findings.regression_test: tracker-routes.test.ts 'rejects paths outside the allowlist' asserts POST /api/tracker/rules is 404.

findings.title: Shared HeartbeatAnswer type omits the 'resume' directive and resume_id the backend sends
findings.proposed_fix: directives: Array<'relogin' | 'resume'>; add resume_id?: string; annotate claim.ts's answer as HeartbeatAnswer so tsc enforces it.
findings.regression_test: Type the heartbeat route's c.json payload with `satisfies HeartbeatAnswer`; typecheck fails on drift.

findings.title: ERP worker-id regex refuses '.' that the console and the VNC route accept
findings.proposed_fix: Use one exported worker-id regex (the console's) for every coordinator.ts route, ideally from packages/shared.
findings.regression_test: coordinator-routes test: GET /api/coordinator/workers/a.b/logins is forwarded, not 400.

findings.title: Proxy round's 30 s console timeout is shorter than the console's worst case when many proxies are down
findings.proposed_fix: Make the ERP timeout exceed ceil(ports/8)*8 s plus the fleet composition (e.g. 60 s, within Cloudflare's 100 s), or have the console cap its total probe time and return partial rows marked timed out.
findings.regression_test: fleet-proxy-health.test.ts: a fake console that answers after 31 s still yields coordinator 'ok' rows.
